messages:
nina: Heads up: after last night's proxy perf tweak some tenants (multi-tenant canary) saw lots of short SSE reconnects. Not a global outage but noisy.
devon: saw that. pattern: long-lived conn -> dropped by proxy under backpressure -> client reconnects immediately -> gets billed for both sessions for ~10s window.
ops-bot: ALERT: sse_reconnect_spike tenant=acme-corp rate=6.2% period=5m sample=zz9
patrick: Can you paste proxy logs for one of the dropped connections?
nina: logs: ```
[proxy-14] conn=78f close_type=preempt_drop reason=lifo_evict queue_len=120 pressure=0.84 route=eu-central
[router] session=abc123 mapped_to=backend-7 next_retry=0.5s
```
harpreet: fifo vs lifo eviction? I thought we were on randomized eviction to reduce tail churn.
devon: We rolled a micro-optimization for cache locality: LIFO evict for socket pool. It reduces CPU but favors newer conns and drops older keepalives. Bad when clients do aggressive reconnect jitter.
patrick: That's likely why clients are double-billed: old session not yet fully tombstoned in billing window BUT proxy made app layer close so client restarts. Billing counts two active sessions.
ina: billing snippet for one tenant: ```
2026-03-10T02:14:12Z tenant=acme tokens=120 session_id=old-abc charge_id=chg-9001
2026-03-10T02:14:13Z tenant=acme tokens=5 session_id=new-def charge_id=chg-9002
```
patrick: We need dedupe key on billing pipeline: prefer last-successful session_id per client_token or use session_uuid TTL before counting as new.
console-ux: Ops teams keep asking for a fast mitigation: a per-tenant toggle in console to fall back to legacy eviction (fifo) so enterprise customers can opt out. Feels like a good temporary UX.
harpreet: Telemetry problem: metrics rollup sampled away the proxy_close_reason. The dashboard shows 'connection_dropped' with no artifact. We need full_reason tag through ingest.
devon: Could also add a short reconnect-suppression grace period at router-level: if proxy evicts and router sees same client_token reconnect within 1s, treat as same session for billing. Low-risk.
patrick: Agree, but that adds state at router. Billing dedupe may be simpler long-term.
ops-bot: NOTE: deploy bot: proxy optimization v2 rolled to canary eu-central at 01:40 UTC (deploy/2026-03-10/opt-v2)
console-ux: UX work: adding a toggle is ~1 day (feature flag + tenancy toggle + doc). I can ship a canary toggle for a few tenants.
nina: Short repro: run 100 clients with jittered reconnect (0-1500ms) + heartbeat=20s, then trigger proxy backpressure (saturate CPU). Observe ~10-20% of connections drop and immediate reconnects.
harpreet: Action items: 1) devon to roll back lifo evict on proxy for canary tenants (P0) 2) patrick to open billing dedupe spike ticket 3) console-ux to deliver per-tenant fallback toggle 4) observability to pass proxy_close_reason through ingest and add recon-flap metric.
devon: I'll push rollback PR: https://git.internal/redwood/proxy/pull/512 and start canary revert.
patrick: Billing ticket: BILL-411 filed with telemetry snippets and suggested dedupe key.
console-ux: PR for toggle: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/4421 (draft).
harpreet: I'll add ingest schema update: add tag `proxy_evict_policy` and `proxy_close_reason`. Rolling change with migration window ~48h.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2039 by nina  /incidents/INC-2039
nina: After rollback to fifo for the affected canary tenants reconnect rate dropped to baseline. Billing spikes still under investigation but reduced. Will follow up in INC-2039 with postmortem and recommended defaults.
console-ux: Follow-up UX note: we should expose queue_len and eviction_policy in the console advanced view so customers can correlate. Filed UX-909.
devon: Long-term plan: revisit pooled-socket eviction heuristics; maybe use age-aware randomized eviction plus backoff hints for clients to reduce thundering reconnects.
patrick: Also add server-side reconnect debounce header that instructs client SDKs to apply exponential jitter after server-initiated close. Could reduce billing churn.
nina: thanks all, closing thread. continuing in INC-2039 channel. :white_check_mark:
